action_comment: It is necessary to use an excess of a β<sub>1</sub>-adrenoceptor-selective ligand such as CGP20712A in combination with this radioligand in order to allow visualisation of β<sub>2</sub>-adrenoceptor binding in native tissues.

assay_description: Inhibitory constant determined from a standard radioligand displacement assay using human β2-adrenoceptors expressed in Sf-9 cells and [<sup>3</sup>H]CGP1217 as tracer.
Determined in an intracellular cAMP accumulation assay in CHO-K1 cells expressing hβ2-AR
